digest.component_or_area: binding_store module extraction and repository pattern
propositions: binding_store.py exceeds sustainable complexity at 800 lines with intermingled file loading, tempfile cleanup, JSON encoding, rotation ordering, and alert persistence that risks silent data loss when refactored without byte-preservation oracles

BindingRepository must be extracted as a private unit-of-work pattern that owns file paths and original dictionaries while preserving all existing load/save byte sequences, exception contracts, and rotation-before-live ordering

each named fault injection (tempfile failure, rotation replace failure, live replace failure, alert write failure) must demonstrate that the refactored implementation survives files and raises/swallows errors identically to the original

public BindingStore facade must remain unchanged in construction, loader, signatures, shared inner dictionaries, and exception visibility to guarantee compatibility with peer_state.py and get_rotation.py
tickets publication via reconcile_helpers.py must continue to stage exactly five bridge-state files with no commit on an unchanged pass
an ADR must document repository unit-of-work durability semantics, ordered partial-state recovery boundaries, selective publication, and the prohibition of journaling and format migration
